name.text: S&P 500 Diversification Challenge - Part A - Selected pair

questiontext.text:
Part A: Enter your selected pair of stocks without any return requirement.

Enter the two tickers in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and without spaces (e.g., AAPL,MSFT).

The 20 highest-ranked eligible pairs receive partial or full credit according to their ranking.

generalfeedback.text: Pairs are scored according to the ranking in the instructor reference results. Rank 1: 100%; ranks 2–5: 90%; 6–10: 80%; 11–15: 70%; 16–20: 60%; otherwise: 0%.
